# SelectField

A native select dressed as a text field. Until something is chosen it shows its placeholder option in grey; after, the small label appears above the value.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/selectfield)

## Usage

```tsx
<SelectField
  label="State"
  placeholder="State"
  value={region}
  options={[{ value: 'CA', label: 'California' }]}
  onChange={event => setRegion(event.target.value)}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | Small label above the chosen value. |
| `value` | `string` | The chosen value. '' means nothing chosen. |
| `options` | `{ value, label }[]` | The choices. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Text of the empty first option. Leave out when a value is always set. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Red border and a message underneath. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `SelectField.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/icons`](../../icons)
- [`src/primitives/Field`](../Field)
- [`src/primitives/FieldError`](../FieldError)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
